title: Egyptian Garlic Chicken Tagine
description: A hearty, garlicky chicken dish from Egypt, cooked in a clay pot with aromatic spices and onions. Low in carbs and high in protein.
instructions: Heat the ghee in a large clay pot or Dutch oven over medium-low heat.
Add the onion rings and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are golden brown and caramelized, about 20 minutes.
Add the chicken to the pot and cook, stirring occasionally, until it is browned on all sides, about 10 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper to the pot and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add 1 cup of chicken broth to the pot and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the oven. Braise the chicken for 25-30 minutes, or until it is cooked through and the meat is tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Stir in the chopped parsley and serve the tagine hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
To deglaze the pot, transfer it to the stovetop and add 2 tablespoons of chicken broth. Scrape up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot with a wooden spoon.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook, stirring constantly, until the liquid has reduced slightly and the sauce has thickened.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with additional parsley and a sprinkle of cumin, if desired.
